research_question: Can one explicit Vietnamese advisory-intent gate stop investment-action questions from entering the numeric financial-statement pipeline without blocking factual or comparison questions?

hypothesis.observed_phenomenon: The current rule planner assigns a numeric-report family even when the user explicitly asks whether they should buy, sell, hold, or invest.
hypothesis.possible_cause: No narrow out-of-scope intent contract runs before numeric family routing.
hypothesis.expected_improvement: Questions matching exact 'co nen' plus one investment action and exactly one ticker should emit an out-of-scope advisory abstention rather than a numeric retrieval plan.
hypothesis.possible_side_effect: A broad 'nen' or action-word rule may capture screening, comparisons, or factual questions and increase false abstention.
hypothesis.questions_that_should_improve: Explicit single-ticker investment-action requests whose expert category is recommendation, valuation, technical, or screening.
hypothesis.questions_that_should_remain_unchanged: Factual lookups, cross-stock comparisons, questions without exact advisory syntax, missing ticker, and multi-ticker questions.

split_design.selection_key: sha256(seed + question + tickers + intrinsic metadata); VNFinsQA ID excluded
split_design.company_holdout: Ticker sets are pairwise disjoint across discovery, development, and untouched evaluation.
split_design.wording_holdout: Normalized wording templates are disjoint between development and untouched evaluation.
split_design.metric_holdout: At least one expert question category occurs in untouched and not development.
split_design.composition_holdout: At least one difficulty plus multi-document signature occurs in untouched and not development.
